theorems.statement: ∀ (P k m n : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) (h : n = k + m) (G : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (S₀ S₀' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (R₀ R₀' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (W₀ K : Set (Euclid P)) (Z E' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (r : ℝ), 0 < k → 0 < m → Orthonormal ℝ g → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) = G → IsMinimizingIn S univ → R.Represents S → R₀.Represents S₀ → R₀'.Represents S₀' → R₀.measure (Gᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∫⁻ t in (G : Set (Euclid P)), R₀.measure ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[k]) → (∀ flat : Covector (Euclid P) n → Covector (Euclid P) m, (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (v : Fin m → Euclid P), flat α v = α (Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, S ω = ∫ t in (G : Set (Euclid P)), currentEval S₀ (fun y => flat ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (t + y))) ∂μHE[k]) → IsOpen W₀ → IsCompact (closure W₀) → (S₀' - S₀).support ⊆ (Gᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ W₀ → IsCompact K → 0 < r → IsIntegerMultiplicity Z → BoundaryVanishes Z → IsCompact Z.support → Z.support ⊆ {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| ≤ r} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' K → (∀ flat : Covector (Euclid P) n → Covector (Euclid P) m, (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (v : Fin m → Euclid P), flat α v = α (Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Z ω = (∫ t in {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r}, currentEval (S₀' - S₀) (fun y => flat ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (t + y))) ∂μHE[k]) + E' ω) → ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * r) ^ k) * S₀.massOn W₀ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * r) ^ k) * S₀'.massOn W₀ + E'.mass
